title: RetirementPet verification fixture registry
description: Machine-readable registry of verification fixtures (CONFORMANCE 4). Markdown lists do not substitute this registry; expectations and hashes may not be silently rewritten.

registry_version.description: Bumped when fixture semantics change; never rewritten in place.

fixture_id.description: Stable ID; never reused for different content.

path.description: Repo-relative path to the fixture artifact.

expected_result.description: For PetPack fixtures: ACCEPT / ACCEPT_WITH_DEGRADATION / REJECT. For Windows/perf scenarios: PASS / FAIL.

expected_codes.description: Stable diagnostic codes required on REJECT or degradation.

scenario.description: Human-readable description of what is exercised.

execution_tier.description: CONFORMANCE 13.1. Lower tiers never substitute higher ones.
